name: squat jerk
description: An Olympic jerk in which you dip and drive the bar overhead, then receive it in a deep squat before standing.
instructions: Start with the barbell in the front rack and your feet about shoulder-width apart.
Make a short, vertical dip by bending your knees while keeping your chest lifted.
Drive forcefully through your legs to send the bar overhead.
Move under the bar into a deep squat and lock your arms overhead, with your feet in a squat stance rather than a split stance.
Stand fully with the bar stable overhead, then lower it safely to the front rack and reset.
